title: Serialize indented JSON as complete server-sent event data
summary: The independent event reader now reconstructs both indented JSON objects. Nested structure and a newline inside a field survived transport and parsed into the intended events.

change.description: Spring adds SSE-aware pretty printing to the Jackson converter and reactive encoder. In the landed revision the reactive writer passes SSE_CONTENT_HINT while the servlet converter checks the response media type.

notes: The caller consumed each flush group and its buffers in order, dispatched data at blank lines, then parsed the complete payload. The compact control passed on both revisions.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-web-5.0.0.M3-q17. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
